competitiveTarget: Beat generic 'list with us' pages: honest value props (real comps, local broker, no hand-offs), a live current-market line, and a single clear valuation CTA, with zero invented results or 'verifiable results' claims (D99).
note: KB (kinetic-brutalist) conversion 2026-06-18 (Phase 9 convergence). Restyled in place: every section, DAL call, FAQ item, internal link, and the #marketing-plan anchor from the prior Wave 3 build are preserved. KbNav + KbFooter carry the chrome; HideChrome for the default SiteHeader/SiteFooter is a shared-component edit deferred to the orchestrator. KbHero replaces the legacy HeroBlock; MetadataBlock (BreadcrumbList + FAQPage JSON-LD) + KbBreadcrumb replace the legacy PageBreadcrumb; KbSectionTracker adds the page-contract tracking. The existing seller sections (SellValueProps, SellProcess, SellMarketingPlan, SellCommission, SellMarketContext, SellValuationCTA, LifestyleStrip, ContentSection 'How it works', CTABar, FAQBlock) render unchanged inside .kb-root with design-system tokens. The lead path is still the /lp/seller-home-value LP; this page embeds no form. Current-market line is live getMarketPulse(Bend), classified by canonical MoS thresholds.
